decisions.statement: The tables are serialized by Lua rather than carried across as values.
A run leaving the map table empty is refused rather than written.
The pseudo map indices are gathered from the globals the upstream file names those indices on.
A run capturing no pseudo map index is refused rather than written.
The ported file names the upstream version the data came out of.
The file written is named to the caller as soon as that file is written.

definition: the map tables upstream LibMapData carries, copied out as TypeScript
